description: Unit test class for the SugarFolder functionality in SuiteCRM, including tests for folder creation, queries, subscriptions, moving, copying, deleting, and retrieving folders and emails within folders.

classes.name: SugarFolderTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for testing SugarFolder class functionalities and related folder operations in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, includes necessary files.

methods.name: testCanGetSugarFolderObject
methods.description: Tests instantiation of a SugarFolder object.

methods.name: testGenerateArchiveFolderQuery
methods.description: Verifies the SQL query generated for archive folders.

methods.name: testGenerateSugarsDynamicFolderQuery
methods.description: Verifies the dynamic folder SQL query generation for different folder types.

methods.name: testClearSubscriptionsForFolder
methods.description: Tests clearing subscriptions for a specific folder.

methods.name: testGetFoldersForSettings
methods.description: Tests retrieval of folder hierarchy for settings, including recursive parent ID fetch.

methods.name: testCrudFolder
methods.description: Tests folder create, update, and delete operations.

methods.name: testCheckFalseIdForDelete
methods.description: Tests deletion attempt on a non-existing folder, expecting failure.

methods.name: testCopyBean
methods.description: Tests copying email beans between folders.

methods.name: testMoveFolder
methods.description: Tests moving a folder within the hierarchy.

methods.name: testGetListItemsForEmailXML
methods.description: Retrieves email items as XML for a folder, testing both static and dynamic folder scenarios.

methods.name: testCountOfItems
methods.description: Verifies email count retrieval methods including new and unread items.

methods.name: testNonExistingRetrieve
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a folder with a non-existent GUID, expecting failure.

methods.name: testDeleteEmailsFromFolder
methods.description: Tests deleting an email from a folder.

methods.name: testDeleteEmailsFromAllFolders
methods.description: Tests deleting an email from all associated folders.

methods.name: testGetUserFolders
methods.description: Tests hierarchical folder retrieval for a user, including nested subfolders and subscriptions.

methods.name: testSetSubscriptionWithNoUser
methods.description: Tests setting subscriptions without providing a user, expecting failure.

methods.name: testUpdateSave
methods.description: Tests saving a folder with modifications.
